# Fixed inputs for the Lokoja regression test

Recorded network responses for a 2 × 2 km box inside the Lokoja example (6.745–6.765° E, 7.775–7.795° N; Sentinel-1 before 2 August 2022, after 13 October 2022), used by `tests/fixture_lokoja.mjs` to run the whole pipeline offline and compare it with `expected.json`.

Sources and licences: Sentinel-1 RTC from Microsoft Planetary Computer (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2022, CC BY 4.0); Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (© DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA); JRC Global Surface Water v1.3 (EC JRC/Google); ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (CC BY 4.0). Signing tokens are left out of the request keys, and the stored token responses were replaced by a placeholder; no credentials are stored.
